name: Sensi Touch 2 (US)

radios.note: Spec sheet lists 802.11 a/b/g/n on 2.4 and 5 GHz plus Bluetooth LE.

matter.note: Matter is not mentioned on Sensi's pages or spec sheet; no CSA listing was checked.

apple_home.note: Sensi's HomeKit support page lists Touch 2 under 'Not Apple HomeKit compatible'; only the original Sensi Touch is listed as compatible.

google_home.note: Works with Google Assistant and Google Home through the Sensi app link.

alexa.note: Voice commands, routines and the Alexa Energy Dashboard via the Sensi skill.

smartthings.note: Sensi lists Samsung SmartThings; its page says it can turn heating on or off.

home_assistant.note: Sensi's pages do not mention Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: Sensi's pages describe Wi-Fi control through the Sensi app but do not say whether a bridge is or isn't needed.

localControl.note: Sensi's pages stress remote control through its app; local control is not stated.

systems.value: Universal: single-stage, multi-stage and heat pump
systems.note: Spec sheet lists gas or electric furnace, AC, boiler and heat pump (4H/2C), plus dual fuel without an outdoor sensor. Models 1F96U-42WF (white) and 1F96U-42WFB (black).

power.note: The spec sheet says all systems require a common wire; Sensi sells a Common Wire Kit (SA11) for homes without one.

summary: Sensi Touch 2 works with Alexa, Google Home and SmartThings, but not Apple Home: Sensi's own HomeKit page lists it as not compatible. It's a wall thermostat for single-stage, multi-stage and heat pump systems, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth built in. Every install needs a C-wire (20-30 V AC), or Sensi's Common Wire Kit.
caveats: Not compatible with Apple HomeKit, according to Sensi's support page.
Needs a C-wire; the Common Wire Kit (SA11) is the option when there is none.
Sensi does not mention Matter or Home Assistant.
